title: New gpt-4o-2024-08-06 model with structured outputs support
description: We've released gpt-4o-2024-08-06, our latest gpt-4o snapshot. This model supports structured outputs via json_schema and offers improved performance on coding tasks.

title: gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 and gpt-3.5-turbo-16k-0613 deprecation
description: gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 and gpt-3.5-turbo-16k-0613 will be retired on September 13, 2024. We recommend migrating to gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 or gpt-4o-mini.

title: Structured outputs now support json_schema for all gpt-4o models
description: All gpt-4o models now support structured outputs via json_schema. Use the response_format parameter with type 'json_schema' to enforce a schema.
